notices.text:
Source family: Lato; real weight/slant: 400/normal
Source repository: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/eb20e9cf19d97cf579fa3867d729d4222d6c59e1
Original static input: Lato-Regular.ttf
Original and static-input SHA-256: d636e4683231f931eda222d588e944d082bfd3bdba02f928bee461c0f185b251
Named family: Resume One LS W400
Final named output SHA-256: 36eaf3e7f62a18134f38b5d60670d6e5b58a75e4bafb1fa83273ba4bc9155b8b
Name-table-only derivative; head checksum updated; invalidated DSIG removed where present. Outlines, metrics, shaping, weight/slant and embedding permissions preserved byte-for-byte. No synthesized weight/slant or variable-font instancing.
Original license: OFL-1.1; complete unchanged text copied separately. Conversion audit SHA-256: 4e03ddf946249398e5a03840659ad758c0bb916c3788ea13dbb15b166a3e3b42

fonts.validation: SHA-256 and static family/weight/slant checked; final core::load_theme and layout validation required
fonts.licensePolicy: declared license and original bytes copied; not a legal clearance

contentPolicy: all standard JSON Resume modules preserved using shared renderer; original custom helpers, field suppression and unsupported visual constructs are not executed

differences.message: 内容由安全标准模块渲染器呈现；不声称自定义模板逻辑、字段呈现或原版分页完全相同
自动布局与导出检查不代替原版逐主题视觉对照

embeddedStyles.limitation: 仅恢复真实 JS 字符串或无动态插值的 style 区域作为数据；未证明加载顺序、最终使用或原模板等价

markupHints.limitation: 只读实际 JSX 节点或字面 HTML；完整源码顺序和同级标题推断，不证明运行时分支或绑定

policy.media: literal print/all, optional only; lists of those types and screen only
policy.nesting: every enclosing media must independently match; unsupported at-rules retained without projection
policy.order: originals retained; append eligible media and subsequent unconditional declarations in original AST order
policy.crossFileOrder: inspection file/block order is inferred; no import, runtime injection, or stylesheet load order is established

limitations: Static print profile inference only; selectors, specificity, inheritance, DOM matching and complete CSS cascade remain unverified.
Feature queries, not queries, unknown conditions, supports, layers and keyframes are not projected.
Syntax evidence omits @keyframes wrappers; ambiguous from/to/numeric step scopes are conservatively rejected, including literal from/to selectors.
Root variables remain limited to the existing same-file :root/html policy; local variables are not promoted.
Projection does not prove original visual equivalence, component reachability, fonts, layout or pagination.
